conditional-probability.text: The probability of A given B equals the probability of the intersection of A and B divided by the probability of B, provided the probability of B is positive.
conditional-probability.title: Conditional probability

bayes-rule.text: For a partition into events A one through A m and positive probability of B: the probability of A j given B is P of B given A j times P of A j, divided by the sum over i of P of B given A i times P of A i.
bayes-rule.title: Bayes rule

counting-and-binomial.text: n choose k equals n factorial divided by k factorial times n minus k factorial, for integer n and k with zero at most k at most n.
counting-and-binomial.title: Counting and binomial

probability-mass-function.text: For a binomial random variable, the probability of k successes equals n choose k times p to the k times one minus p to the n minus k.
probability-mass-function.title: Probability mass function

piecewise-function.text: F of x is zero below zero, x between zero and one inclusive, and one above one.
piecewise-function.title: Piecewise function

integral-and-infinity.text: The integral from negative infinity to infinity of the standard normal density equals one.
integral-and-infinity.title: Integral and infinity

matrix-and-greek.text: A two by two covariance matrix Sigma with variances sigma one squared and sigma two squared on the diagonal and covariance rho times sigma one times sigma two off the diagonal.
matrix-and-greek.title: Matrix and greek

aligned-derivation.text: The sum of squared deviations about a equals the sum of squared deviations about the mean plus n times the squared difference between the mean and a.
aligned-derivation.title: Aligned derivation
